title: AI Mega-Financing: SoftBank's OpenAI Stake & Broadcom's $60B for Anthropic Chips
summary: Gotrade News - Two of the largest private AI bets on record moved forward this week. According to Seeking Alpha , citing Bloomberg News, a Wall Street
body_markdown:
SoftBank funded the last tranche with proceeds from an $11.1 billion foreign-currency bond sale announced on September 24, The Next Web reported. The group also drew $30 billion of a $40 billion bridge loan signed in March, repaid $25.9 billion in early September, and cancelled the remaining $10 billion on September 30.


The commitment was part of OpenAI's $122 billion funding round at an $852 billion valuation, per The Next Web. Other major backers in that round include Amazon, with a $50 billion commitment, and[Nvidia (NVDA)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) , with $30 billion.
